s = socket.socket(socket.AF_UNIX, socket.SOCK_STREAM)
s.connect('/run/haproxy/admin.sock')
s.sendall(b'show stat\n')
data = b''
while True:
    part = s.recv(65536)
    if not part:
        break
    data += part
s.close()
lines = data.decode().splitlines()
header = next(x for x in lines if x.startswith('# '))[2:].split(',')
idx = [header.index(x) for x in ('pxname','svname','status','check_status','check_code')]
for line in lines:
    if line.startswith('nginx_nodes,'):
        row = line.split(',')
        print('POST_RESTART_POOL ' + ' '.join(row[i] for i in idx))
